blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Severe Tropical Storm Queenie is now nearing typhoon category, said the state weather bureau on Saturday, after gaining strength since early morning. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) in its latest typhoon bulletin, Queenie was last spotted 575 kilometers (km) east northeast of Itbayat, Batanes. READ: Queenie may become a typhoon by Sept. 27 It currently carries maximum sustained winds of 110 km per hour (kph) and gustiness of up to 135 kph while moving northwestward at 10 kph over the Philippine Sea.
